example.title: Doxie Creek Bridge, Missouri State Route 5 over Doxie Creek
example.place: Forest Green vicinity, Chariton County, MO
example.photo_note: the drawings are HAER photographic copies of the 1927-28 state highway and shop drawings (general elevation, 70 ft span, bearings, railing)

brief: State-highway standard riveted Warren pony truss (with verticals), 1929: a five-span, 403 ft crossing on a 69-degree skew, a 100 ft centre span of five 20 ft panels and four 70 ft spans, trusses 10 ft high and 22 ft 2 in apart over a 20 ft two-lane concrete deck on concrete column bents. Laced channel top chords with cover plates, batten-plated angle diagonals, 10 in concrete curbs with weepholes, and an inner railing of single angle posts at mid-panel carrying two gas-pipe rails that end at ornamental ball-topped posts; W-beam guardrail on the approaches. A cast plate on each end post reads the highway department, bridge number and year. For the 13.4 m crossing use a single short span of this design (two to three 20 ft panels).

names.plate: STATE HIGHWAY DEPT · BRIDGE No. H.412 · 1929
